summary_brief: 3月20日标志着AI Agent生态系统从能力积累走向规范化整合：MCP协议的推送通道功能首次打破请求-响应模式，实现真正的双向实时通信；安全优先设计从可选增强演进为框架默认配置（拒绝默认策略、提示拦截钩子）；推理参数（reasoning_effort）跨SDK标准化，使推理深度控制成为可移植能力；评估框架扩展至跨生态对比（gptme vs Claude Code），推动Agent能力可量化。这些变化共同指向Agent从实验性工具向生产级系统的转型进入深水区。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 协议深度集成与推送通道突破
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: MCP (Model Context Protocol) 正在成为 Agent 工具调用的标准协议，Claude Code 新增的推送通道允许 MCP 服务器主动向会话推送消息，打破了传统的请求-响应模式，为实时交互和后台任务通知开辟了新可能。

engineering_signals.title: AI 框架安全优先设计理念兴起
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个主流框架实施安全默认值强化策略，包括 Semantic Kernel 对插件实施拒绝默认策略、OpenAI Codex 提供用户提示拦截钩子，以及多个项目修复路径遍历、SQL 注入等安全漏洞，标志着 AI 框架向安全优先设计的重要转变。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 评估框架走向规范化与跨生态对比
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 评估套件扩展至 7 个批次覆盖 25+ 编程任务，并实现跨 Agent 框架（gptme vs Claude Code）的横向评估对比能力。同时 CI 中引入启发式检测区分 API 配额错误与真实测试失败，提升了 eval 系统的可观测性和诊断效率。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 配置抽象与定义能力扩展
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Claude Agent SDK 的 AgentDefinition 新增 skills、memory 和 mcpServers 字段，配合插件市场源的声明式配置，为复杂 Agent 的定义和管理提供了更完整的抽象层，降低了 Agent 开发的复杂性。

engineering_signals.title: 推理能力配置参数标准化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个 AI SDK 正在标准化推理能力配置参数（reasoning_effort），Vercel AI SDK、Semantic Kernel、Mistral 等相继支持，使开发者能够控制不同模型的推理深度和资源消耗，提升复杂任务的解决能力。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 会话隔离与并行执行能力提升
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Gemini CLI 支持 Git Worktree 并行会话隔离，结合远程执行环境与沙箱隔离能力，解决了多任务并行开发时的上下文冲突问题，同时增强了安全性和资源隔离能力。

engineering_signals.title: SDK 类型安全与 Schema 能力增强
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Anthropic Python SDK 增强 Schema Transform 对 Enum 的支持，结合 Vercel AI SDK 对 Google 多模态工具结果的支持，以及 WebP 图像格式支持，提升了 LLM 应用的类型安全性和多模态能力边界。

release_signals.title: Claude Code MCP 推送通道
release_signals.why_it_matters: 允许 MCP 服务器主动向会话推送消息，打破了传统的请求-响应模式，为实时交互和后台任务通知开辟了新可能。

release_signals.title: AutoGPT AutoPilot 块与 GitHub CLI 集成
release_signals.why_it_matters: AutoPilotBlock 允许从图中调用 AutoPilot，结合 GitHub CLI 集成，实现了 Agent 之间协作和代码仓库操作的深度自动化。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Codex 用户提示提交钩子
release_signals.why_it_matters: 提供了在用户提示执行前进行拦截、修改或阻止的能力，为构建安全护栏和提示工程管道提供了关键基础设施。

release_signals.title: Semantic Kernel 安全默认值强化
release_signals.why_it_matters: 对 WebFileDownloadPlugin 和 DocumentPlugin 实施拒绝默认策略，标志着 AI 框架向安全优先设计的重要转变。

release_signals.title: Claude Agent SDK AgentDefinition 扩展
release_signals.why_it_matters: AgentDefinition 新增 skills、memory 和 mcpServers 字段，提供了更完整的 Agent 配置抽象，简化了复杂 Agent 的定义和管理。

release_signals.title: Vercel Flags 嵌入式定义默认启用
release_signals.why_it_matters: 构建时自动获取并嵌入 Flag 定义，简化了功能开关的部署流程，提升了开发体验。

release_signals.title: AI SDK Google 多模态工具结果支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: 支持将图像和文件数据作为工具结果传递给 Google 模型，扩展了多模态 Agent 的能力边界。

release_signals.title: Mistral 推理配置支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: 为 mistral-small-latest 模型添加推理配置支持，使开发者能够控制模型的思考深度和资源消耗。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 内联插件市场源
release_signals.why_it_matters: 允许在 settings.json 中直接声明插件条目，简化了插件管理流程，提升了配置的可移植性。

release_signals.title: Agent-Browser 认证登录就绪性改进
release_signals.why_it_matters: 通过智能选择器检测和分阶段等待策略，显著提升了 SPA 页面认证登录的可靠性，解决了时序失败问题。

### New Features

- **AgentDefinition**: Added `skills`, `memory`, and `mcpServers` fields (#684)
- **AssistantMessage usage**: Preserve per-turn `usage` on `AssistantMessage` (#685)
- **Session tagging**: Added `tag_session()` with Unicode sanitization (#670)
- **Session renaming**: Added `rename_session()` (#668)
- **RateLimitEvent**: Added typed `RateLimitEvent` message (#648)

### Bug Fixes

- **CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT**: Use default-if-absent semantics to match TS SDK (#686)
- **Fine-grained tool streaming**: Reverted the env-var workaround from 0.1.48; partial-message delivery is now handled upstream (#671)

### Internal/Other Changes

- Updated bundled Claude CLI to version 2.1.77
- Added macOS x86_64 wheel to the published matrix (#661)
- Upload wheel-check artifacts in CI (#662)
- Docs: clarified `allowed_tools` as a permission allowlist (#649)

```bash
pip install claude-agent-sdk==0.1.49
```

**Date:** March 2026

---

## 🔥 What's New?

### New Features

### Enhancements

- **#12438** - Enable SmartDecisionMakerBlock in agent generator (by @majdyz)
- **#12446** - Add direct ID lookup to find_agent and find_block tools (by @majdyz)

### UI/UX Improvements

- **#12444** - Replace custom LibraryTabs with design system TabsLine (by @Abhi1992002)
- **#12462** - Comprehensive marketplace UI redesign (by @0ubbe)
- **#12484** - Collapse navbar text to icons below 1280px (by @0ubbe)
- **#12463** - Constrain markdown heading sizes in user chat messages (by @0ubbe)

### Bug Fixes

- **#12390** - Auto-parse structured data and robust type coercion (by @majdyz)
- **#12316** - Show sub-folders when navigating inside a folder (by @Abhi1992002)
- **#12401** - Sync TranscriptBuilder with CLI on mid-stream compaction (by @majdyz)
- **#12394** - Prioritize block discovery over MCP and sanitize HTML errors (by @Otto-AGPT)
- **#12409** - Downgrade agent validation failure log from error to warning (by @Otto-AGPT)
- **#12430** - Reduce Sentry noise by filtering expected errors and downgrading log levels (by @majdyz)
- **#12362** - Fix image delete button on EditAgentForm (by @Abhi1992002)
- **#12400** - Split CamelCase block names and filter disabled blocks before batch slicing (by @majdyz)
- **#12445** - Handle transient Anthropic API connection errors gracefully (by @majdyz)
- **#12399** - Fix tool-result file read failures across turns (by @majdyz)
- **#12025** - Truncate filenames with excessively long 'extensions' (by @Deeven-Seru)
- **#12028** - Allow falsy entries in AddToListBlock (by @Deeven-Seru)
- **#12413** - Try-compact-retry for prompt-too-long errors in CoPilot SDK (by @majdyz)
- **#12451** - Pre-check invite eligibility before Supabase signup (by @Otto-AGPT)
- **#12466** - Arch-conditional chromium in Docker for ARM64 compatibility (by @0ubbe)
- **#12474** - Remove dead Tutorial button from TallyPopup (by @Otto-AGPT)
- **#12481** - Rename "CoPilot" to "AutoPilot" on credits page (by @Otto-AGPT)
- **#12485** - Revert invite system (by @Pwuts)
- **#12490** - Revert "feat(backend): migrate OpenAI provider to Responses API" (by @ntindle)

### Testing

- **#12437** - Improve end-to-end CI & reduce its cost (by @Pwuts)
- **#12433** - Add integration tests for builder stores, components, and hooks (part-1) (by @Abhi1992002)
- **#12435** - Add integration tests for builder UI state stores and draft recovery (part-2) (by @Abhi1992002)
- **#12436** - Add builder e2e tests for new Flow Editor (by @Abhi1992002)
- **#12453** - Python version specific type checking (by @Pwuts)

### Documentation

- **#11989** - Add workspace and media file architecture documentation (by @ntindle)
- **#12458** - Update CLAUDE.md (by @Pwuts)
- **#12491** - Add TDD guidance to CLAUDE.md files (by @Otto-AGPT)

### Dependencies & Maintenance

- **#12459** - Update `poetry` to v2.2.1 (by @Pwuts)
- **#12479** - Make Builder and Marketplace search work without embeddings (by @Otto-AGPT)

---

To update to this version, run:

```bash
git pull origin autogpt-platform-beta-v0.6.52
```

Or download it directly from the  
[Releases page](https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT/releases).

For a complete list of changes, see the [Full Changelog](https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT/compare/autogpt-platform-beta-v0.6.51...autogpt-platform-beta-v0.6.52).

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please [join our Discord](https://discord.gg/autogpt) and let us know!

## [1.0.0rc5] - 2026-03-19

>[!IMPORTANT]
> For any breaking changes & updates, please view this [migration guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/agent-framework/support/upgrade/python-2026-significant-changes).

### Added

- **samples**: Add foundry hosted agents samples for python ([#4648](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4648))
- **repo**: Add automated stale issue and PR follow-up ping workflow ([#4776](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4776))
- **agent-framework-ag-ui**: Emit AG-UI events for MCP tool calls, results, and text reasoning ([#4760](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4760))
- **agent-framework-ag-ui**: Emit TOOL_CALL_RESULT events when resuming after tool approval ([#4758](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4758))

### Changed

- **agent-framework-devui**: Bump minimatch from 3.1.2 to 3.1.5 in frontend ([#4337](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4337))
- **agent-framework-devui**: Bump rollup from 4.47.1 to 4.59.0 in frontend ([#4338](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4338))
- **agent-framework-core**: Unify tool results as `Content` items with rich content support ([#4331](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4331))
- **agent-framework-a2a**: Default `A2AAgent` name and description from `AgentCard` ([#4661](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4661))
- **agent-framework-core**: [BREAKING] Clean up kwargs across agents, chat clients, tools, and sessions ([#4581](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4581))
- **agent-framework-devui**: Bump tar from 7.5.9 to 7.5.11 ([#4688](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4688))
- **repo**: Improve Python dependency range automation ([#4343](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4343))
- **agent-framework-core**: Normalize empty MCP tool output to `null` ([#4683](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4683))
- **agent-framework-core**: Remove bad dependency ([#4696](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4696))
- **agent-framework-core**: Keep MCP cleanup on the owner task ([#4687](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4687))
- **agent-framework-a2a**: Preserve A2A message `context_id` ([#4686](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4686))
- **repo**: Bump `danielpalme/ReportGenerator-GitHub-Action` from 5.5.1 to 5.5.3 ([#4542](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4542))
- **repo**: Bump `MishaKav/pytest-coverage-comment` from 1.2.0 to 1.6.0 ([#4543](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4543))
- **agent-framework-core**: Bump `pyjwt` from 2.11.0 to 2.12.0 ([#4699](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4699))
- **agent-framework-azure-ai**: Reduce Azure chat client import overhead ([#4744](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4744))
- **repo**: Simplify Python Poe tasks and unify package selectors ([#4722](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4722))
- **agent-framework-core**: Aggregate token usage across tool-call loop iterations in `invoke_agent` span ([#4739](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4739))
- **agent-framework-core**: Support `detail` field in OpenAI Chat API `image_url` payload ([#4756](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4756))
- **agent-framework-anthropic**: [BREAKING] Refactor middleware layering and split Anthropic raw client ([#4746](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4746))
- **agent-framework-github-copilot**: Emit tool call events in GitHubCopilotAgent streaming ([4711](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4711))

### Fixed

- **agent-framework-core**: Validate approval responses against the server-side pending request registry ([#4548](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4548))
- **agent-framework-devui**: Validate function approval responses in the DevUI executor ([#4598](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4598))
- **agent-framework-azurefunctions**: Use `deepcopy` for state snapshots so nested mutations are detected in durable workflow activities ([#4518](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4518))
- **agent-framework-bedrock**: Fix `BedrockChatClient` sending invalid toolChoice `"none"` to the Bedrock API ([#4535](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4535))
- **agent-framework-core**: Fix type hint for `Case` and `Default` ([#3985](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/3985))
- **agent-framework-core**: Fix duplicate tool names between supplied tools and MCP servers ([#4649](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4649))
- **agent-framework-core**: Fix `_deduplicate_messages` catch-all branch dropping valid repeated messages ([#4716](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4716))
- **samples**: Fix Azure Redis sample missing session for history persistence ([#4692](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4692))
- **agent-framework-core**: Fix thread serialization for multi-turn tool calls ([#4684](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4684))
- **agent-framework-core**: Fix `RUN_FINISHED.interrupt` to accumulate all interrupts when multiple tools need approval ([#4717](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4717))
- **agent-framework-azurefunctions**: Fix missing methods on the `Content` class in durable tasks ([#4738](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4738))
- **agent-framework-core**: Fix `ENABLE_SENSITIVE_DATA` being ignored when set after module import ([#4743](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4743))
- **agent-framework-a2a**: Fix `A2AAgent` to invoke context providers before and after run ([#4757](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4757))
- **agent-framework-core**: Fix MCP tool schema normalization for zero-argument tools missing the `properties` key ([#4771](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/4771))

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/compare/python-1.0.0rc4...python-1.0.0rc5

key_changes: 【破坏性变更】清理 agents、chat clients、tools 和 sessions 中的 kwargs 参数，需参考迁移指南
新增 Foundry 托管 agents 的 Python 示例代码
AG-UI 模块增强：支持 MCP 工具调用、结果和文本推理的 AG-UI 事件发射
核心模块统一工具结果为 Content 类型，支持富内容
A2A 模块优化：A2AAgent 名称和描述默认从 AgentCard 获取
ai_summary.summary_cn: 这是 1.0.0rc5 候选版本，包含一个重要的破坏性变更：清理了 agents、chat clients、tools 和 sessions 中的 kwargs 参数，用户需参考官方迁移指南进行升级。同时新增了 Foundry 托管 agents 示例，增强了 AG-UI 对 MCP 工具调用的事件支持，并统一了工具结果的数据结构。

## What's changed

- Added `rate_limits` field to statusline scripts for displaying Claude.ai rate limit usage (5-hour and 7-day windows with `used_percentage` and `resets_at`)
- Added `source: 'settings'` plugin marketplace source — declare plugin entries inline in settings.json
- Added CLI tool usage detection to plugin tips, in addition to file pattern matching
- Added `effort` frontmatter support for skills and slash commands to override the model effort level when invoked
- Added `--channels` (research preview) — allow MCP servers to push messages into your session
- Fixed `--resume` dropping parallel tool results — sessions with parallel tool calls now restore all tool_use/tool_result pairs instead of showing `[Tool result missing]` placeholders
- Fixed voice mode WebSocket failures caused by Cloudflare bot detection on non-browser TLS fingerprints
- Fixed 400 errors when using fine-grained tool streaming through API proxies, Bedrock, or Vertex
- Fixed `/remote-control` appearing for gateway and third-party provider deployments where it cannot function
- Fixed `/sandbox` tab switching not responding to Tab or arrow keys
- Improved responsiveness of `@` file autocomplete in large git repositories
- Improved `/effort` to show what auto currently resolves to, matching the status bar indicator
- Improved `/permissions` — Tab and arrow keys now switch tabs from within a list
- Improved background tasks panel — left arrow now closes from the list view
- Simplified plugin install tips to use a single `/plugin install` command instead of a two-step flow
- Reduced memory usage on startup in large repositories (~80 MB saved on 250k-file repos)
- Fixed managed settings (`enabledPlugins`, `permissions.defaultMode`, policy-set env vars) not being applied at startup when `remote-settings.json` was cached from a prior session

新增 settings 插件源，支持在 settings.json 中内联声明插件
修复 --resume 恢复会话时丢失并行工具结果的问题
大幅优化大型 git 仓库的启动内存占用（25万文件仓库节省约 80MB）

## New Features
- App-server TUI now supports device-code ChatGPT sign-in during onboarding and can refresh existing ChatGPT tokens. (#14952)
- Plugin setup is smoother: Codex can prompt to install missing plugins or connectors, honor a configured suggestion allowlist, and sync install/uninstall state remotely. (#14896, #15022, #14878)

releases.summary:
### Minor Changes

-   Emit Vercel Flags embedded definitions by default ([#15487](https://github.com/vercel/vercel/pull/15487))

    When you deploy to Vercel, the build process fetches your latest flag definitions once at build time using the Vercel CLI and bundles them into the deployment.

    This used to require opt-in by setting `VERCEL_EXPERIMENTAL_EMBED_FLAG_DEFINITIONS=1`, and has now been switched to be enabled by default. You can opt out by setting `VERCEL_FLAGS_DISABLE_DEFINITION_EMBEDDING=1`.

    Definitions are only fetched in case there is at least one environment variable containing a Vercel Flags SDK key.

    [See docs](https://vercel.com/docs/flags/vercel-flags/sdks/core#embedded-definitions)

### Patch Changes

-   757626f: ### Bug Fixes

    -   **Deduplicate text content in snapshots** - Fixed an issue where duplicate text content appeared in page snapshots (#909)
    -   **Native mouse drag state** - Fixed incorrect raw native mouse drag state not being properly tracked across `down`, `move`, and `up` events (#872)
    -   **Chrome headless launch failures** - Fixed browser launch failures caused by the `--enable-unsafe-swiftshader` flag in Chrome headless mode (#915)
    -   **Origin-scoped `--headers` persistence** - Restored correct persistence of origin-scoped headers set via `--headers` across navigation commands (#894)
    -   **Relative URLs in WebSocket domain filter** - Fixed handling of relative URLs in the WebSocket domain filter script (#624)

ai_summary.summary_cn: 此版本为补丁更新，共修复了 5 个 Bug，主要涉及页面快照、鼠标交互、浏览器启动和 WebSocket 过滤器等方面的稳定性问题。重点解决了 Chrome headless 模式下的启动失败和文本快照重复内容等影响用户体验的问题。

changes.description: WebFileDownloadPlugin 安全默认值加固，采用更严格的默认安全策略
DocumentPlugin 安全默认值加固，AllowedDirectories 改为默认拒绝访问
清理 agents、chat clients、tools 和 sessions 中的 kwargs 参数，统一接口签名
重构 Anthropic 中间件层并拆分原始客户端，影响底层客户端调用方式

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本次分析覆盖 20 个仓库，识别出 **5 类跨仓库共性问题**（共 295 个 Issue），其中最严重的是 workflow_runtime 类别的任务执行失败（158 Issue, P0），以及 auth_permission 类别的 API 密钥组织隔离缺失（38 Issue, P0）。另有 3 个仓库出现高影响单仓问题。
global_highlights: workflow_runtime 跨 44 仓：任务执行失败（Block 错误、MCP 超时、CLI 挂起、流式错误处理缺陷）
auth_permission 跨 24 仓：API 密钥缺少 org_id 验证、sandbox 静默降级、第三方提供商认证失败
tool_call_protocol 跨 18 仓：工具描述超长截断、消息解析失败、MCP 通知丢弃、流式错误码错误
高影响单仓 P0：OpenDevin V1 自托管不稳定（6 Issue）、anthropics/claude-code-action 输出不发布（4 Issue）

top_pain_points.topic: API密钥组织隔离缺失：/users/me不返回org_id且密钥可跨组织访问
top_pain_points.summary: API密钥的安全隔离存在漏洞：(1)/users/me端点不返回API密钥所属的org_id，导致调用者无法确定操作的组织上下文；(2)API密钥可以访问用户所属的其他组织端点而无org_id验证，导致org-scoped密钥实际上成为user-scoped身份令牌。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 明显的权限隔离缺陷：多租户环境下API密钥组织隔离失效，虽然不是主流程阻断但存在安全风险，影响企业用户的多组织使用场景

source_issues.title: [Bug]: /users/me endpoint does not return API key's org_id
source_issues.evidence: 用API密钥认证调用/users/me无法确定密钥属于哪个组织，GET /api/orgs返回的current_org_id可能不同于密钥创建时的组织

source_issues.title: [Bug]: API keys can access cross-org endpoints without org_id validation
source_issues.evidence: API密钥验证只返回user_id忽略org_id，require_permission只检查用户成员身份不验证密钥是否为该组织创建，导致Org A密钥可访问Org B端点

source_issues.title: Unable to connect to bitbucket repo
source_issues.evidence: User reports that Bitbucket token authentication URL format (https://x-token-auth:mytoken@bitbucket.org/workspace/repo.git) works with git CLI but fails in Tabby. Error log shows: 'Failed to clone repository: Failed to clone https://bitbucket.org/workspace/repository'. This blocks users from adding private Bitbucket repos as context source.

source_issues.title: `edit` permission rules do not override `external_directory: "allow"` for write operations
source_issues.evidence: User configured external_directory allow + edit deny, but writes proceed without prompts - documented use case for read-only external access is impossible to achieve

source_issues.title: Invalid Argument errors when using Vertex with `google-github-actions/auth`
source_issues.evidence: 用户在使用GitHub Actions联邦认证调用Vertex AI时持续收到400 Invalid Argument错误，导致CI/CD中的测试无法运行，而本地环境正常工作

source_issues.title: eager_input_streaming breaks Bedrock deployments: "Extra inputs are not permitted"
source_issues.evidence: 使用 include_partial_messages=True 在 Bedrock 部署上立即失败，报错 'Extra inputs are not permitted'，有明确的复现步骤和根因分析

source_issues.title: [Bug] SDK maps thinking={"type":"disabled"} to --max-thinking-tokens 0, which breaks Anthropic-compatible providers

source_issues.title: sandbox.enabled: true silently degrades to unsandboxed execution when bubblewrap is not installed
source_issues.evidence: Detailed reproduction shows sandbox configuration is completely ignored. User explicitly configured allowedDomains and allowWrite expecting enforcement. False sense of security - callers cannot detect that sandboxing failed to initialize programmatically.

source_issues.title: Bedrock auth broken since v1.0.74 — "Could not load credentials from any providers" despite valid OIDC credentials
source_issues.evidence: Bedrock-based PR review workflow stopped working. OIDC step succeeds, AWS credentials present in env, but Claude Code fails with 'Could not load credentials from any providers'. Never makes an API call.

source_issues.title: 403 when using ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL with LiteLLM proxy
source_issues.evidence: LiteLLM proxy returns 403. Same credentials and endpoint work with standard Anthropic SDK. Agent SDK binary appears to bypass ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL or not forward auth headers correctly.

top_pain_points.topic: Task execution failures - planned tasks fail to complete
top_pain_points.summary: Users experience errors when attempting to run planned tasks via the play button, with tasks failing to complete as expected
top_pain_points.review_reason: Blocks core user workflow of executing planned tasks. User cannot complete their intended work, though more details needed for full diagnosis.

source_issues.title: Failed planned
source_issues.evidence: User reports repeated errors when hitting play with a simple prompt, tasks fail to complete

source_issues.title: fix: auto-select search backend with fallbacks, hide unavailable engines
source_issues.evidence: The search() function currently defaults to DuckDuckGo, which is broken due to bot detection. This leads to wasted steps when agents try DDG first, get an error, then retry with Perplexity.

source_issues.title: gpt-5.4 via openai-subscription: thinking leaks + tool fumbling
source_issues.evidence: gpt-5.4 via openai-subscription has significantly worse autonomous performance: 58% productive vs 88% productive over 24 vs 8 sessions. Issues include <thinking> tag leaks, tool call fumbling (repeated @todo with empty results, @gh failures), and shell quoting failures with $'\n' escape sequences.

source_issues.title: V1 self-hosted: conversation reaches READY and first LLM completion succeeds, but no assistant or action events are persisted

signals.topic: API密钥组织隔离缺失：/users/me不返回org_id且密钥可跨组织访问

signals.review_reason: 明显的权限隔离缺陷：多租户环境下API密钥组织隔离失效，虽然不是主流程阻断但存在安全风险，影响企业用户的多组织使用场景

source_issues.title: [Bug]: API keys can access cross-org endpoints without org_id validation

signals.topic: 开发工作流中断：docker-dev留下root权限文件、local runtime启动失败
signals.summary: 开发者在本地开发时遇到的问题：(1)make docker-dev在挂载源目录创建root拥有的文件，退出后在主机运行make run/start-frontend因EACCES权限错误失败；(2)RUNTIME=local模式因libtmux 0.31.0移除Session.attached_pane而启动崩溃。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: make docker-dev leaves root-owned files in host source tree, breaking subsequent host builds

source_issues.evidence: local_runtime.py使用已废弃的session.attached_pane，libtmux 0.31.0已移除该属性，应使用session.active_pane

signals.review_reason: 高频(count>=3)主流程阻断问题：多个不同Block（图像生成、视频创建、LLM调用、搜索）在执行时抛出运行时错误，直接导致用户自动化工作流失败。这些都是核心功能点，错误会阻断用户完成预期任务。

source_issues.evidence: 图像生成Block执行时抛出BlockUnknownError，用户无法完成图像生成任务

source_issues.evidence: 视频创建Block因权限问题失败，用户无法使用视频生成功能

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: raised by AIListGeneratorBlock with message: Error calling LLM: Error code: 401 - Incorrect API key
source_issues.evidence: LLM调用Block因API key问题失败，影响依赖LLM的工作流

source_issues.title: BlockUnknownError: raised by ExaSearchBlock with message: Unknown error occurred
source_issues.evidence: 搜索Block执行时出现未知错误，用户无法使用搜索功能

signals.topic: 后端调度器连接断开导致任务执行失败

signals.review_reason: 后端调度器是平台核心组件，连接断开会直接导致定时任务无法执行。虽然count=1，但错误具有周期性和持续性特征，影响用户对自动化平台的信任度。

source_issues.title: [Bug report] submission - ClientNotConnectedError: Client is not connected to the query engine
source_issues.evidence: 后端调度器错误日志显示'Client is not connected to the query engine, you must call connect() before attempting to query data'，每15分钟发生一次，影响调度任务的正常执行

signals.topic: Copilot任务失败后不显示错误信息

signals.review_reason: 用户运行任务失败后无法及时获知原因，需要额外操作才能发现问题，这是明显的用户体验问题。在自动化场景中，及时的错误反馈对用户调试和信任至关重要。

source_issues.title: [Bug report] Failure to report task failure?

signals.summary: 前端Select组件在运行时从受控状态切换到非受控状态，触发React警告，可能影响表单交互的稳定性
signals.review_reason: 前端组件状态管理问题可能导致表单交互异常，虽然不直接阻断主流程，但影响用户体验的稳定性和专业性。

signals.topic: Bitbucket repository authentication fails with token-based URL
signals.summary: Users cannot connect private Bitbucket repositories using the standard x-token-auth URL format that works with git CLI
signals.review_reason: Core functionality (connecting code repositories for context) is completely blocked for users with private Bitbucket repos using token authentication. User provides clear error logs and demonstrates the auth method works in standard git CLI but not in Tabby's integrated client.

source_issues.title: Unable to connect to bitbucket repo
source_issues.evidence: User reports that Bitbucket token authentication URL format (https://x-token-auth:mytoken@bitbucket.org/workspace/repo.git) works with git CLI but fails in Tabby. Error log shows: 'Failed to clone repository: Failed to clone https://bitbucket.org/workspace/repository'. This blocks users from adding private Bitbucket repos as context source.

signals.topic: GPT-5 model causes bad_request error in chat

signals.review_reason: Core chat functionality fails when using GPT-5 model. User demonstrates that the same API configuration works with GPT-4.1 and also works with GPT-5 in their own project, proving this is a Tabby-specific integration issue that prevents legitimate use of the latest OpenAI model.

source_issues.title: gpt-5 from openai does not work for the chat
source_issues.evidence: User reports that configuring GPT-5 in config.toml results in 'bad_request' error for every chat message. User confirmed the same API key and endpoint works with GPT-5 in their own project, indicating the issue is specific to Tabby's implementation rather than the OpenAI API itself.

source_issues.title: [Bug]:使用reme长期记忆，陷入死循环

signals.review_reason: 影响多模态场景的图片处理功能，某些实际场景（如 QQ 等平台的 CDN URL）会下载无扩展名文件

signals.summary: MilvusStore 查询时未正确设置 topK 参数，导致向量检索失败
signals.review_reason: RAG 功能的核心组件 Milvus 向量存储查询失败，导致知识库检索不可用，issue 已关闭但反映了真实 bug

signals.topic: output_schema breaks core Agent functionality (skills, streaming)
signals.summary: When output_schema is enabled, it conflicts with other core features: skills become non-functional (#7096) and streaming is forced to non-streaming mode causing API failures for long requests (#7044). Users cannot use structured output together with skills or long-running operations.
signals.review_reason: Clear user impact: output_schema feature breaks other core Agent functionality (skills and streaming), causing workflow failures. Two distinct manifestations of root conflict between structured output and other Agent features. Users cannot combine these commonly-used features.

source_issues.title: 当加载 skill 的时候同时启用output_schema时， skill失效
source_issues.evidence: User reports skill stops working when output_schema is enabled, but works when output_schema is removed. Direct functional regression affecting user workflow.

source_issues.title: [Bug] output_schema forces non-streaming API call, breaking Anthropic Claude models with long requests
source_issues.evidence: Forces non-streaming API call causing Anthropic SDK to reject requests with 'Streaming is required for operations that may take longer than 10 minutes' - complete workflow failure for long-running operations.

signals.topic: CustomEvent serialization loses dynamically-set fields on session reload
signals.summary: CustomEvent fields set via __init__ kwargs are silently dropped during RunOutput.to_dict() serialization. Custom events stream correctly but all custom fields are lost when sessions are persisted and reloaded.
signals.review_reason: Clear user impact: documented API behavior (CustomEvent dynamic fields) silently fails during session persistence, causing data loss on reload. Breaks session-based workflows where custom event data must survive persistence.

source_issues.title: [Bug] CustomEvent dynamic attributes lost during session serialization (asdict drops setattr fields)
source_issues.evidence: User demonstrates that CustomEvent fields set via kwargs are lost on serialization - assert 'my_field' in serialized FAILS. Direct data loss affecting session persistence.

source_issues.title: CustomEvent dynamic attributes lost during session serialization (asdict)
source_issues.evidence: Duplicate report of same issue - CustomEvent.__init__ uses setattr but to_dict() uses asdict() which only serializes declared dataclass fields.

signals.topic: Knowledge base search returns duplicate documents with LanceDB
signals.summary: When using LanceDB as vector store, knowledge base search queries return duplicate documents, reducing search result quality and potentially confusing agents with redundant information.
signals.review_reason: Affects search result quality for users using LanceDB as knowledge base vector store. Reduces usefulness of knowledge retrieval feature, though not a complete workflow block.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Knowledge|LanceDB search return duplicate documents
source_issues.evidence: User provides reproduction code showing knowledge.search() returns duplicate documents from LanceDB.

signals.topic: Memory optimization can cause permanent user data loss
signals.summary: aoptimize_memories performs delete + insert operations without transaction wrapping. If connection drops after delete but before inserts complete, user memories are permanently lost with no recovery mechanism.
signals.review_reason: Critical user impact: data loss bug where user memories can be permanently deleted without recovery. Though count=1, the severity of potential user data loss warrants P1 priority.

source_issues.title: bug(aoptimize_memories): delete + insert is not atomic, can lose user data
source_issues.evidence: Issue clearly demonstrates non-atomic DB operations that can result in permanent user memory data loss.

signals.topic: Structured output schema handling breaks Optional field validation
signals.summary: sanitize_response_schema() unconditionally marks all fields as required, even Optional fields with default=null. This mismatch causes structured output failures when LLM omits optional fields.
signals.review_reason: Breaks structured output feature for users with Optional fields in their schemas. Causes intermittent failures that are difficult to debug.

source_issues.title: [Bug] sanitize_response_schema() marks all optional fields as required, breaking Structured Outputs for models with Optional fields
source_issues.evidence: User demonstrates intermittent structured output failures due to schema/Pydantic model mismatch for Optional fields.

signals.topic: Windows platform startup and installation failures
signals.summary: Windows users experience critical failures including directory corruption with junction loops and reserved names, WSL2 crashes with 'Illegal instruction', and inability to uninstall the application. These issues persist across reinstalls and block users from using OpenCode entirely.
signals.review_reason: High-frequency (3 issues) Windows platform failures that completely block users from starting or managing OpenCode. Issues span installation, runtime, and uninstall scenarios, making the product unusable for Windows users.

source_issues.title: [Windows] Persistent Directory Corruption - Junction Loops & Reserved Names (nul file)
source_issues.evidence: Corruption blocks Windows users from using OpenCode IDE, cannot uninstall cleanly, requires manual PowerShell cleanup, corruption returns after reinstall

source_issues.title: opencode exits immediately with Illegal instruction on WSL2/Linux
source_issues.evidence: Binary crashes with 'Illegal instruction', making both CLI and ACP unusable - complete startup failure on WSL2

source_issues.title: Cant uninstall desktop throught install desktop
source_issues.evidence: User cannot uninstall the desktop application, uninstaller gives error and cannot proceed

signals.topic: Ollama/local model integration - extreme latency and subagent failures
signals.summary: Local models via Ollama take 60-90 seconds to respond to simple prompts (vs 3s for direct API calls), and Ollama subagents execute tools correctly but return empty text to orchestrators, breaking multi-agent workflows.
signals.review_reason: Local model users experience unusable latency (20-30x slower than expected) and broken subagent workflows. While not blocking cloud model users, this significantly impacts users relying on local/Ollama models for cost or privacy reasons.

source_issues.title: Local models via Ollama take 60-90s to respond to simple prompts like 'hi', while direct API calls take 3s
source_issues.evidence: OpenCode adds ~75s internal overhead for local models, direct curl to Ollama takes 3s but OpenCode takes 60-90s for every message

source_issues.title: Ollama subagent executes tool calls correctly but always returns empty text to orchestrator
source_issues.evidence: Subagent tools execute correctly (files written, bash runs) but orchestrator receives empty string - multi-agent workflows fail

signals.topic: Subagent identity and execution failures across models
signals.summary: Subagents lose their identity after first tool call, reverting to primary agent and spawning excessive subagents. GLM-5 model gets stuck in infinite loops repeating same actions. These issues break complex multi-step agent workflows.
signals.review_reason: Complex agent workflows completely fail due to identity swapping and infinite loops. Users cannot rely on subagent delegation for multi-step tasks, forcing manual intervention or abandonment of advanced features.

source_issues.title: Subagent identity swapping after first tool call
source_issues.evidence: After first tool call, subagent reverts to primary agent, loses tool access, spawns dozens of new subagents instead of completing task

source_issues.title: GLM-5 model gets stuck in infinite loop, repeating same actions
source_issues.evidence: GLM-5 model performs same tool calls repeatedly indefinitely instead of progressing - task never completes, wastes resources

signals.topic: Cost tracking underestimation with OpenRouter cache tokens
signals.summary: When using OpenRouter, cache write tokens are not accounted for in cost tracking, causing displayed costs to be significantly lower than actual billing (user reported $4 estimated vs $20 actual).
signals.review_reason: Significant financial impact - users cannot trust the in-app cost tracker when using OpenRouter, leading to unexpected charges. This directly affects budget-conscious users and enterprise cost management.

source_issues.title: Cache write tokens not accounted for when using OpenRouter, causing cost underestimation
source_issues.evidence: User saw $4 estimated cost but actual OpenRouter billing was $20 - 5x discrepancy due to missing cacheWriteInputTokens tracking

signals.topic: Permission rules not overriding external_directory allow settings
signals.summary: When external_directory is set to 'allow' for a path, adding 'edit' permission rules with 'ask' or 'deny' has no effect. Write/edit operations proceed without prompting, contradicting documented behavior and creating security risks.
signals.review_reason: Security-related configuration is completely ignored, preventing users from implementing read-only access to external directories. This contradicts official documentation and creates potential for unintended file modifications.

source_issues.title: `edit` permission rules do not override `external_directory: "allow"` for write operations
source_issues.evidence: User configured external_directory allow + edit deny, but writes proceed without prompts - documented use case for read-only external access is impossible to achieve

signals.topic: StopReason enum missing model_context_window_exceeded value

signals.review_reason: 这是一个SDK功能缺失，会导致用户在遇到上下文窗口超限时无法正确识别和处理该停止原因，影响应用程序的错误处理逻辑

source_issues.title: Register model_context_window_exceeded StopReason
source_issues.evidence: 用户发现在官方迁移指南中提到的model_context_window_exceeded StopReason在SDK的StopReason enum中未定义，导致无法正确处理该停止原因

signals.topic: Vertex AI authentication fails with GitHub Actions federated identity
signals.summary: 在GitHub Actions环境中使用google-github-actions/auth联邦认证访问Vertex AI时，SDK返回Invalid Argument错误，阻断CI/CD流程
signals.review_reason: 这是一个阻断性问题，会导致用户在GitHub Actions CI/CD环境中无法使用SDK访问Vertex AI，影响自动化测试和部署流程

source_issues.title: Invalid Argument errors when using Vertex with `google-github-actions/auth`
source_issues.evidence: 用户在使用GitHub Actions联邦认证调用Vertex AI时持续收到400 Invalid Argument错误，导致CI/CD中的测试无法运行，而本地环境正常工作

signals.topic: Streaming error handling issues (status code and error message defects)
signals.summary: SDK在处理流式错误时存在两个问题：1) SSE错误返回错误的status_code=200而非实际错误码(如529)，导致重试/回退逻辑失效；2) 非Beta路径下JSON解析错误消息无上下文，用户无法定位问题
signals.review_reason: 两个问题都导致用户在生产环境中遇到实际影响：SSE错误码错误会破坏重试/回退逻辑，JSON错误消息不清晰增加调试难度。有明确的复现步骤和真实用户影响证据。

source_issues.title: Mid-stream SSE errors get `status_code=200` instead of the actual error code
source_issues.evidence: User hit this in production with pydantic-ai's FallbackModel, which checks status_code >= 500 to decide whether to try the next model. The overloaded error had status_code=200, so fallback never fired.

source_issues.title: Streaming tool use: unhelpful error message when model emits malformed JSON
source_issues.evidence: Every user of client.messages.stream() with tool calling is affected. When this triggers, there is no indication that the error came from tool input JSON parsing, no mention of what JSON was received. It looks like an SDK crash.

signals.topic: MCP connector network blocking on claude.ai

signals.review_reason: 功能完全不可用是关键用户痛点。付费用户($200/月)无法使用宣传的功能，有明确的网络层封锁证据(HTTP 403)，属于服务配置问题导致的阻断性故障。

source_issues.title: MCP connectors non-functional on claude.ai — mcp.etherscan.io hardblocked at network level
source_issues.evidence: Pro subscribers paying $200/month cannot use advertised MCP integrations. Curl test shows HTTP 403 with x-deny-reason: host_not_allowed. The egress proxy allowlist does not include mcp.etherscan.io.

signals.topic: Vertex AI structured outputs BadRequestError
signals.summary: 使用AnthropicVertex SDK的messages.parse方法进行结构化输出时，在Claude 4.6模型上始终返回BadRequestError，功能完全不可用
signals.review_reason: 结构化输出是完全阻断的功能故障，用户无法使用SDK提供的核心功能(parse方法)。有完整的复现代码和多个SDK版本验证，属于平台兼容性问题。

source_issues.title: Structured outputs with Claude 4.6 on Vertex AI results in error
source_issues.evidence: BadRequestError: Error code: 400 - output_config.format: Extra inputs are not permitted. Tested with anthropic[vertex] version 0.80.0 and 0.82.0. Complete reproduction code provided.

signals.topic: toBase64 crashes with stack overflow on large inputs in non-Node environments (browsers, Cloudflare Workers)
signals.summary: The toBase64 utility in the SDK crashes with 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' error when processing inputs larger than ~100KB in non-Node environments. This blocks users from uploading images or large files when using the SDK in browsers or edge workers.
signals.review_reason: User-facing runtime crash: the SDK's built-in toBase64 utility fails catastrophically (stack overflow) when processing large inputs (>100KB) in non-Node environments. This blocks the core use case of uploading images or large files from browsers and edge workers. Evidence: clear reproduction steps provided, crash is immediate and blocking.

source_issues.title: toBase64 stack overflow on large inputs (e.g. image uploads) in non-Node environments
source_issues.evidence: Issue explicitly demonstrates reproduction: 'const large = new Uint8Array(200 * 1024); toBase64(large); // Crashes with RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded'. This is a blocking crash that prevents users from uploading images/large files in browser and Cloudflare Workers environments.

signals.topic: Compaction docs example causes adjacent assistant messages error
signals.summary: The official compaction documentation example preserves an even number of messages, which results in adjacent assistant messages after compaction - a protocol violation that can cause API errors.
signals.review_reason: Documentation bug that can cause users following the official example to encounter API errors due to invalid message sequences. While the issue is now closed (docs likely fixed), it represents a real user pain point where copying official examples leads to failures. Lower priority as it's documentation-related and already resolved.

source_issues.title: Bug in pause_after_compaction docs?
source_issues.evidence: Issue identifies a logic bug in the official documentation example: preserving 2 messages after compaction creates adjacent assistant messages (compaction result + aN-1), which violates the message alternation requirement.

signals.topic: SDK 与第三方 API 提供商（Bedrock/兼容提供商）兼容性问题
signals.summary: SDK 在使用 AWS Bedrock 或其他 Anthropic 兼容提供商时存在多个兼容性问题：1) eager_input_streaming 参数被 Bedrock 拒绝；2) thinking={'type':'disabled'} 设置被错误映射为 --max-thinking-tokens 0，在兼容提供商上无法正确禁用思考功能。
signals.review_reason: 影响使用 Bedrock 或其他兼容提供商的用户，导致 SDK 核心功能（流式消息、思考控制）完全不可用，属于主流程阻断

source_issues.title: eager_input_streaming breaks Bedrock deployments: "Extra inputs are not permitted"
source_issues.evidence: 使用 include_partial_messages=True 在 Bedrock 部署上立即失败，报错 'Extra inputs are not permitted'，有明确的复现步骤和根因分析

source_issues.title: [Bug] SDK maps thinking={"type":"disabled"} to --max-thinking-tokens 0, which breaks Anthropic-compatible providers
source_issues.evidence: 用户设置 thinking={'type':'disabled'} 后，兼容提供商仍然返回 ThinkingBlock，说明意图未被正确传递

signals.topic: SDK MCP Server 工具调用在长时间运行后失败（Stream closed）
signals.summary: SDK MCP Server 的自定义工具调用在约 60-70 秒后开始失败，返回 'Stream closed' 错误，而内置工具（Read、Grep）仍正常工作。根因是 CLI 未在 MCP 服务器响应到达时重置 lastActivityTime，导致非活动计时器超时后关闭流。
signals.review_reason: 用户在长时间运行的 agent 工作流中反复遇到此问题，导致自定义 MCP 工具完全不可用，属于主流程阻断。TS SDK 有相同问题并已修复，Python SDK 待修复。

source_issues.title: [BUG] SDK MCP server tool calls fail with "Stream closed" after ~70s - Python SDK v0.1.47
source_issues.evidence: 用户报告 SDK MCP server 工具调用在 60-70 秒后失败，有详细的 JSONL 日志证据显示工具调用与失败仅相隔 1-5ms，工具根本没机会执行

signals.topic: CLI 在合成阶段无限期挂起
signals.summary: Agent SDK CLI 在完成工具调用后无限期挂起，无法进行结果合成。相同工作负载通过 Messages API 可在约 79 分钟内完成，但通过 SDK CLI 会永远卡住。用户报告 5 次运行均复现此问题。
signals.review_reason: 主流程完全阻断，用户无法获得 agent 执行结果。问题已关闭但仍有参考价值，表明此类问题可能再次发生

source_issues.title: Agent SDK CLI hangs indefinitely during synthesis after successful tool calls
source_issues.evidence: 用户提供了详细的 5 次运行记录表格，显示工具调用正常完成后 CLI 永久挂起，有完整的环境信息和复现代码

signals.topic: SDK 无法解析 CLI 发出的 rate_limit_event 消息
signals.summary: SDK v0.0.25 在 CLI 发出 rate_limit_event 消息时抛出 MessageParseError，导致每次查询都失败。这是因为消息解析器对未知消息类型直接抛出异常而非容错处理。
signals.review_reason: 影响使用 Max 订阅的用户，每次查询都会失败，属于主流程阻断。用户需要 monkey-patch 才能 workaround

source_issues.title: MessageParseError on rate_limit_event from CLI (v0.0.25)
source_issues.evidence: 使用 Max 订阅 OAuth 时每次查询都触发此错误，有具体的错误消息和事件 payload

signals.topic: Docker 环境下设置 DEBUG 环境变量导致 SDK 失效
signals.summary: 在 Docker 环境中设置 DEBUG 环境变量（任意值）时，Claude Code 会打印沙箱调试信息，随后 Python 进程无法从迭代器接收任何消息并静默退出。不设置 DEBUG 或在非 Docker 环境下工作正常。
signals.review_reason: 影响在 Docker 环境中使用 SDK 的用户（常见的部署方式），设置 DEBUG 变量（常见调试实践）会导致 SDK 完全失效

source_issues.title: Python SDK is broken in Docker environment with DEBUG env var and Claude Code 2.0.43+
source_issues.evidence: 有完整的 Dockerfile 复现步骤，明确指出 DEBUG 环境变量触发的沙箱调试消息导致 SDK 失效

signals.topic: SDK returns vague/contradictory error information
signals.summary: When errors occur (e.g., network failure), the SDK returns subtype 'error_during_execution' with is_error: false and an empty errors array, making it impossible for developers to show meaningful error messages to users or diagnose root causes programmatically.
signals.review_reason: P1 because error handling is core to any SDK usage. When network fails, developers cannot display meaningful errors to end users, degrading user experience significantly. The contradictory fields (error_during_execution + is_error: false) indicate a protocol bug.

source_issues.title: More descriptive Errors in the SDK
source_issues.evidence: User shows real output: subtype 'error_during_execution' but is_error: false, and empty errors array when wifi dies. User needs to show nice errors to users but cannot due to missing error details.

signals.topic: Sandbox silently degrades to unsandboxed execution
signals.summary: When sandbox.enabled: true is set but bubblewrap is not installed, the SDK silently falls back to completely unsandboxed execution with no error or warning to the caller. All Bash commands run with full filesystem and network access, ignoring allowWrite and allowedDomains configuration.
signals.review_reason: P0 because this is a security-critical bug. Users who configure sandbox settings expect those protections to be enforced. Silent fallback creates a false sense of security - the configuration is silently ignored. This could lead to unintended data exposure or security breaches in production.

source_issues.title: sandbox.enabled: true silently degrades to unsandboxed execution when bubblewrap is not installed
source_issues.evidence: Detailed reproduction shows sandbox configuration is completely ignored. User explicitly configured allowedDomains and allowWrite expecting enforcement. False sense of security - callers cannot detect that sandboxing failed to initialize programmatically.

signals.topic: Custom systemPrompt ignored by agent since v0.2.15
signals.summary: Custom systemPrompt strings are effectively ignored starting from v0.2.15. The SDK prepends 'You are a Claude agent...' which overrides custom role/behavior instructions. This breaks all custom workflow agents that define their own system prompts for specialized behavior.
signals.review_reason: P0 because this is a regression that breaks core functionality. Users building specialized agents (code review, payment page dev, etc.) cannot upgrade past v0.2.14. The injected SDK prefix takes precedence over user-defined system prompts, breaking production workflows that rely on custom agent roles and behaviors.

source_issues.title: Custom systemPrompt string ignored by agent in v0.2.15+
source_issues.evidence: User demonstrates version-specific regression: works in v0.2.14, broken in v0.2.15+. API inspection shows injected prefix overriding custom content. User had to lock to v0.2.14, blocking all upgrades. This breaks custom workflow agents that need specialized agent behavior.

signals.topic: File checkpointing not functional in SDK (non-interactive) mode
signals.summary: enableFileCheckpointing: true is effectively non-functional when using query() programmatically. rewindFiles() always returns 'No file checkpoint found' because snapshot creation is only implemented in React/Ink interactive UI code paths, never called in SDK mode.
signals.review_reason: P1 because a documented feature (enableFileCheckpointing) is completely non-functional in SDK mode. Users who need file rollback capabilities in automated workflows cannot use this feature. The option is accepted but silently does nothing, wasting developer time in debugging.

source_issues.title: File checkpointing snapshots not created in SDK (non-interactive) mode
source_issues.evidence: User provides detailed root cause analysis: snapshot creation function is only called inside React/Ink interactive UI code paths. The feature simply doesn't work in SDK mode despite the option being accepted. File tracking silently fails with 'Missing most recent snapshot'.

signals.topic: ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug breaks SDK protocol
signals.summary: Setting ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug for debugging causes SDK failure. Debug logs are written to stdout, corrupting the JSON protocol used for parent-child communication. This prevents users from debugging API-level issues when using the SDK.
signals.review_reason: P1 because it breaks the standard debugging workflow. When things go wrong (auth issues, rate limits), ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug is the primary diagnostic tool. Having this broken in the SDK makes debugging significantly harder and forces users to implement custom workarounds.

source_issues.title: ANTHROPIC_LOG=debug corrupts SDK protocol - debug logs should go to stderr
source_issues.evidence: User shows error: 'CLI output was not valid JSON' when using standard Anthropic debug env var. Root cause identified: debug logs go to stdout instead of stderr, corrupting protocol. Standard debugging tool is broken, making auth failures and rate limits impossible to diagnose.

signals.topic: Comment/Output Not Posted Despite Successful Execution
signals.summary: Claude Code Action runs successfully (consuming tokens, executing tools) but frequently produces no visible GitHub comment. The action's built-in comment-posting mechanism fails silently, logging 'No buffered inline comments' even when Claude generated substantial output. Affects code-review plugin, issue_comment triggers, and PR-triggered workflows when no inline diff comments are generated.
signals.review_reason: Critical UX failure: Users spend API credits and wait for reviews that complete successfully but produce no visible output. This breaks the core workflow promise - a successful run should produce visible feedback. Multiple independent reports confirm this is a systemic issue across different trigger types and configurations.

source_issues.title: code-review plugin completes review but produces empty result — no PR comment posted
source_issues.evidence: Plugin generates thorough review (correctly identified 2 real bugs), but session ends with empty result because final turn is TodoWrite instead of text message. No comment posted to PR.

source_issues.title: PR-triggered workflows produce no visible output when Claude has no inline diff comments
source_issues.evidence: When prompt instructs Claude to post a review, action only posts inline review comments. If no line-specific feedback, nothing gets posted at all.

source_issues.title: claude-code-action silently drops output comments on issue_comment triggers
source_issues.evidence: Workflow completes with success, Claude uses ~350k input tokens, but no comment posted. Logs show 'No buffered inline comments'.

source_issues.title: Auto-review should post a comment when no issues are found (silent clean pass)
source_issues.evidence: Auto-review runs 5+ minutes successfully but exits silently with no PR comment when no issues found. PR author cannot tell if review ran or failed.

signals.topic: restoreConfigFromBase Feature Causes Failures on Non-Standard Repo Configurations
signals.summary: The restoreConfigFromBase feature (introduced in v1.0.74) causes multiple failure modes: (1) hangs indefinitely on repos with .gitmodules/submodules, (2) fails with 'couldn't find remote ref main' on repos with non-main default branches (master, release/*, etc.), (3) fails on issue_comment events when branch detection logic falls back to hardcoded 'main'. Blocks all workflows on affected repos.
signals.review_reason: Complete workflow blockage: Users with repos using 'master' or containing submodules cannot use the action at all. The indefinite hang (4+ hours) is particularly severe as it wastes CI minutes and requires manual cancellation. Multiple related failure modes indicate architectural issues with branch detection logic.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase hangs indefinitely on repositories with .gitmodules (submodules)
source_issues.evidence: Job ran for ~4 hours until manually cancelled. Hang occurs when git operations on .gitmodules trigger submodule-related commands that block waiting for input.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on repos with non-"main" default branch
source_issues.evidence: Fails with 'fatal: couldn't find remote ref main' when repo uses 'master' or any non-main default branch. baseBranch falls back to hardcoded 'main' in multiple locations.

source_issues.title: restoreConfigFromBase fails on issue_comment events when default branch is not main
source_issues.evidence: On issue_comment events, restoreBase attempts to fetch origin/main regardless of actual default branch. Action fails entirely when 'main' doesn't exist.

signals.topic: Authentication/Provider Failures Break API Connectivity
signals.summary: Multiple authentication paths are broken: (1) Bedrock auth stopped working after v1.0.74 with 'Could not load credentials from any providers' despite valid OIDC credentials, (2) LiteLLM proxy auth returns 403 because agent SDK doesn't properly forward ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/auth headers, (3) OIDC token exchange returns 500 errors for extended periods. These break the core functionality of connecting to AI APIs.
signals.review_reason: Core functionality broken: Users cannot connect to AI APIs through multiple authentication paths. Bedrock users completely blocked. The OIDC 500 error affected all users for 7+ hours. These are complete workflow failures, not edge cases.

source_issues.title: Bedrock auth broken since v1.0.74 — "Could not load credentials from any providers" despite valid OIDC credentials
source_issues.evidence: Bedrock-based PR review workflow stopped working. OIDC step succeeds, AWS credentials present in env, but Claude Code fails with 'Could not load credentials from any providers'. Never makes an API call.

source_issues.title: 403 when using ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL with LiteLLM proxy
source_issues.evidence: LiteLLM proxy returns 403. Same credentials and endpoint work with standard Anthropic SDK. Agent SDK binary appears to bypass ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL or not forward auth headers correctly.

source_issues.title: OIDC App token exchange returning 500 Internal Server Error since Mar 18 12:00 UTC
source_issues.evidence: All workflows using claude_code_oauth_token failing for 7+ hours. App token exchange returns 500 Internal Server Error on all retry attempts. Action never reaches Claude execution.

signals.topic: Installation/Setup Failures Block Action Execution
signals.summary: Multiple installation failure modes: (1) v1 action fails with 403 when install.sh cannot download specified Claude Code version, (2) Marketplace plugin install fails on non-ephemeral self-hosted runners with 'already installed' error on subsequent runs. Both prevent the action from running at all.
signals.review_reason: Startup failures prevent action from running at all. The 403 installation error affected all v1 users. Self-hosted runner issue is a significant pain point for users with persistent runners.

source_issues.title: v1 action fails to install Claude Code v2.1.79 (403 from install.sh)
source_issues.evidence: install.sh returns 403 when downloading v2.1.79 native binary. Affects all repos using @v1. Misleading 'Claude Code installed successfully' message printed despite failure.

source_issues.title: Marketplace install fails on non-ephemeral self-hosted runners: 'already installed'
source_issues.evidence: On non-ephemeral self-hosted runners, second run fails because marketplace persists in ~/.claude/. No safe workaround for concurrent jobs.

signals.topic: Node.js 20 Deprecation Warning
signals.summary: The action's dependency on oven-sh/setup-bun uses deprecated Node.js 20 runtime. GitHub will force Node.js 24 starting June 2, 2026, potentially breaking the action.
signals.review_reason: Visible warning on every workflow run creates poor user experience. While not blocking now, will become critical when GitHub forces Node.js 24 in June 2026. Two separate reports indicate this is affecting multiple users.

source_issues.title: update claude-code-action to use node24
source_issues.evidence: GitHub shows deprecation warning for oven-sh/setup-bun using Node.js 20. Will be forced to Node.js 24 on June 2, 2026.

source_issues.title: oven-sh/setup-bun dependency uses deprecated Node.js 20
source_issues.evidence: Same root cause as #1050 - oven-sh/setup-bun pinned version uses Node.js 20 which is deprecated.

signals.topic: Unbounded API costs on large PRs with no actionable output
signals.summary: Users experience runaway API bills when scanning large PRs - documented case of $70+ total cost across multiple attempts with zero actionable findings. Single PR consumed 1.3M tokens (~$8) with no output.
signals.review_reason: Real user pain point with documented cost impact ($70+ wasted with no output). However, marked P2 because: (1) count=1 (single issue), (2) issue is closed suggesting potential fix, (3) only affects large PRs which is an edge case. The evidence shows actual financial loss for users, qualifying as a genuine pain point.

source_issues.title: [FEATURE] Add configurable token budget / max cost cap to prevent runaway API bills on large PRs
source_issues.evidence: Issue #63 documents a case where a single PR scan consumed 1.3M tokens (~$8 USD) and produced zero findings — with the user reporting $70+ total across multiple attempts with no actionable output.

signals.topic: MCP channel notifications silently dropped - Telegram/Discord plugins non-functional for receiving messages
signals.summary: MCP servers using notifications/claude/channel to deliver inbound messages are silently dropping all notifications. The MCP connection works (tools are registered), but inbound notifications never appear in the session. This renders channel plugins like Telegram and fakechat unusable for receiving messages from external channels.
signals.review_reason: Core functionality failure - users cannot use channel plugins to receive messages from Telegram/Discord. This breaks the entire remote control workflow that channel plugins are designed for. Has reproducible steps and affects multiple platforms (macOS, Windows).

source_issues.title: MCP notifications/claude/channel notifications not delivered to session (Telegram plugin)
source_issues.evidence: User confirmed MCP notification is sent successfully via debug logs, but Claude Code does not process/forward the notification. Session never receives <channel> message. Outbound MCP tools work correctly but inbound notifications fail completely.

source_issues.title: [BUG] notifications/claude/channel MCP notifications silently dropped — channel plugins (Telegram, fakechat) non-functional
source_issues.evidence: Multiple plugins affected (telegram, fakechat). Tested on both stable (2.1.62) and latest (2.1.80) versions on Windows. MCP connection works but all inbound notifications are dropped silently.

signals.topic: Model quality degradation after service outages - hallucination and unverified assumptions
signals.summary: Multiple users report consistent degradation in Claude's response quality following recent service outages. Symptoms include increased hallucinations, making assumptions without verifying root causes, and overconfident reasoning without knowledge verification.
signals.review_reason: Direct user impact on core functionality - users experience degraded AI quality that affects their work. Multiple independent reports of same pattern (degradation after outages) suggest a systemic issue rather than isolated cases.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Claude responses degraded after recent service outage
source_issues.evidence: User reports 'Claude makes a total mess out of everything consistently in every session since the outage 2 days ago.' Issue is reproducible across sessions after the outage period.

source_issues.title: [Bug] Model hallucination and unverified assumptions increased after recent outages
source_issues.evidence: User reports 'Claude is constantly hallucinating and making assumptions without verifying the root cause. This happens every session now, did not happen before outages this week.'

signals.topic: Windows plugin marketplace add fails with ENOENT on NTFS case-insensitive rename
signals.summary: When installing plugins from marketplace on Windows, the installation fails with ENOENT error because Claude Code attempts to rename a directory from mixed-case to lowercase on NTFS, which is case-insensitive by default and considers source and target the same path.
signals.review_reason: Blocks plugin installation on Windows for repos with mixed-case org names. Has clear reproduction steps. Platform-specific but affects significant user base (Windows users).

source_issues.title: Windows: plugin marketplace add fails with ENOENT on case-insensitive NTFS rename
source_issues.evidence: User provides clear reproduction steps: on Windows NTFS, /plugin marketplace add fails when GitHub org name has mixed case (e.g., MediQuant/marketplace). fs.rename() throws ENOENT because OS considers source and target the same path.

signals.topic: bypassPermissions mode reverts unexpectedly during session
signals.summary: When using Shift+Tab to change mode to bypassPermissions, the mode reverts back to 'accept' mode after a few seconds, even when defaultMode: bypassPermissions is set in settings. This forces users to repeatedly change the mode.
signals.review_reason: Disrupts workflow by forcing repeated permission mode changes. Settings are not respected, breaking user expectation of persistent configuration. Affects productivity during active sessions.

source_issues.title: [BUG] "Shift+Tab" mode change reverts after a few seconds despite defaultMode: bypassPermissions in settings
source_issues.evidence: User reports that bypassPermissions mode spontaneously reverts to accept mode in certain sessions. Once this happens, even resetting to bypassPermissions doesn't persist. Settings configuration is ignored.

signals.topic: Terminal auto-scrolls to top during active session
signals.summary: During active Claude Code sessions, the terminal frequently and involuntarily scrolls back to the beginning of the conversation. This erratic behavior makes it impossible to stay at the current position and disrupts the workflow.
signals.review_reason: Significant UX disruption - users cannot maintain their position in long conversations. The erratic scrolling behavior interferes with reading output and following progress. Marked duplicate indicates multiple reports.

source_issues.title: Terminal keeps scrolling to top of conversation during active session
source_issues.evidence: User reports screen frequently scrolls to top during active session, making it impossible to stay at current position. Behavior is described as 'erratic/frantic' and disrupts workflow significantly.

signals.topic: Usage quota transparency and model quality degradation on Opus 4.6
signals.summary: Users cannot verify promotional usage multipliers (e.g., '2x usage promo') due to lack of usage counter/API, and observe significant quality degradation on Opus 4.6 including reasoning shortcuts, fabricated numbers in calculations, and pattern-matching instead of actual computation.
signals.review_reason: Real user pain point: paying users cannot verify if promotional benefits are delivered, and experience degraded model quality that directly impacts their work outcomes (incorrect calculations, failed reasoning tasks). However, marked P2 due to single issue and insufficient cross-repo evidence.

source_issues.title: [Usage Transparency] No way to verify '2x usage promo' + Observed quality degradation on Opus 4.6
source_issues.evidence: User on Max plan reports: (1) No counter/API to verify promotional usage; (2) Base limits appear reduced before promo; (3) Opus 4.6 quality dropped - model takes shortcuts, makes up numbers instead of computing, pattern-matches instead of solving. Multiple Reddit threads corroborate quality issues during March 17-20, 2026.

signals.topic: Telegram plugin silently disconnects or crashes mid-session
signals.summary: Telegram bot polling stops working silently during sessions due to missing error handling on grammy long-polling. Users experience: bot stops receiving messages, crashes on MCP restart with 409 Conflict, requires --channels flag to work, Windows compatibility issues with Bun runtime, zombie processes after session ends, and conflicts when running multiple sessions with same bot token.
signals.review_reason: High-frequency issue (7 distinct reports) blocking the primary use case of Telegram plugin - sending and receiving messages. Users experience complete workflow disruption with silent failures, requiring terminal intervention and full restarts to recover. Multiple independent reporters confirm the problem across different environments (macOS, Windows).

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin: bot polling dies silently, requires full restart
source_issues.evidence: Bot stops receiving inbound messages mid-session, requiring a full Claude Code restart to recover. Outbound tools remain available but no new messages arrive from Telegram.

source_issues.title: bug(telegram): server crashes on 409 Conflict during MCP restart
source_issues.evidence: Server crashes every time Claude Code restarts it (e.g. after a session reconnect or /mcp reload). GrammyError: Call to 'getUpdates' failed! (409: Conflict)

source_issues.title: Telegram MCP server disconnects in normal mode, requires --channels flag
source_issues.evidence: In normal mode, the MCP server disconnects automatically. Telegram messages sent to the bot get no response. Only works with --channels flag.

source_issues.title: Bug Report: Telegram MCP Server Not Receiving Messages on Windows
source_issues.evidence: Bot never receives messages on Windows. Grammy with Bun fails with 409 Conflict error while curl polling works.

source_issues.title: fix(telegram): two sessions with same bot cause 409 Conflict
source_issues.evidence: If you open two Claude Code sessions with the same Telegram bot token, both try to poll Telegram simultaneously. Telegram responds with 409 Conflict - both sessions crash or miss messages.

source_issues.title: fix(telegram): bot becomes zombie process when Claude Code session ends
source_issues.evidence: When you close a Claude Code session, the Telegram bot keeps running forever as a zombie process. It holds the bot token and blocks the next session from polling.

source_issues.title: Telegram plugin: four resilience issues causing silent disconnects
source_issues.evidence: bot.start() rejection crashes process with no error handling. No bot.catch() middleware causes crashes on middleware errors. stdin close not detected leaves zombie processes.

signals.topic: Telegram inbound messages not delivered to Claude conversation
signals.summary: Inbound Telegram messages are received by the bot (typing indicator fires) but the MCP notification never surfaces in the Claude Code conversation, so Claude never sees or replies to user messages.
signals.review_reason: Core functionality failure - messages arrive at the bot but never reach Claude, completely breaking the remote messaging workflow. User cannot use Telegram to interact with Claude at all. Distinct from general disconnect issues as this has specific root cause (fire-and-forget notification with no error handling).

source_issues.title: Telegram channel: inbound notifications not delivered to conversation
source_issues.evidence: Bot shows 'is typing...' confirming message passed the gate and handleInbound() executed, but the notifications/claude/channel notification never surfaces in Claude Code conversation.

signals.topic: Discord bot stalls when agent generates a plan
signals.summary: When using Discord plugin, if the agent comes up with a plan, the Discord bot stalls until the user proceeds with the plan from the terminal. The plan options are not sent to Discord, breaking remote usage.
signals.review_reason: Breaks the core value proposition of Discord plugin - remote control of Claude Code. User must physically access terminal to proceed, defeating purpose of remote channel integration. Clear user impact with screenshots provided showing the stall behavior.

source_issues.title: Discord bot stalls after the agent comes up with a plan
source_issues.evidence: When a plan is generated, the agent awaits for user input in the terminal. Options should be sent to Discord but they are not, forcing user to go into terminal to select an option.

signals.topic: Max plan subscription verification fails on Telegram channel requests
signals.summary: After successful pairing, Telegram messages fail with 'LLM request rejected: unable to verify membership benefits' error even though user has active Claude Max plan subscription.
signals.review_reason: Blocks paying Max plan subscribers from using channel features entirely. Authentication succeeds but LLM requests fail, suggesting issue with channel-specific auth flow. User has valid subscription but cannot use feature they're entitled to.

source_issues.title: Channels: "LLM request rejected: unable to verify membership benefits" on Max plan after successful pairing
source_issues.evidence: After pairing succeeds with 'Paired! Say hi to Claude.', subsequent messages fail with 'LLM request rejected: We're unable to verify your membership benefits.' Auth status confirms Max plan is active.

signals.topic: Discord edits don't trigger push notifications for task completion
signals.summary: When assistant uses edit_message to update a progress message with final results, Discord doesn't send push notifications. Mobile users miss task completion unless actively watching the channel.
signals.review_reason: UX degradation for mobile users who rely on push notifications. Task results can be missed entirely if user isn't actively monitoring Discord. Has a straightforward fix (send new reply instead of edit) via system instructions update.

source_issues.title: Discord: edits don't trigger push notifications — guide assistant to send new reply on completion
source_issues.evidence: User won't know task finished unless actively watching the channel when assistant edits the 'working...' message with results instead of sending a new reply.

signals.topic: Admin API workspace management - archived workspaces auto-recreated with org-level spend limit
signals.summary: When using Admin API to manage workspaces for cost control, archived workspaces are being automatically recreated (possibly via Console) and inherit the organization's maximum spend limit, causing cost control mechanisms to fail completely
signals.review_reason: This is a clear user pain point with tangible impact: cost control mechanism fails when archived workspaces are auto-recreated and inherit org-level spend limits. User has documented the issue occurring 3 times in 2 days and had to implement a workaround (AWS Lambda). The issue blocks the primary use case of managing per-user spend limits via workspace isolation.

source_issues.title: [Admin API] Archived workspace is automatically recreated and assigned org-level spend limit
source_issues.evidence: User created ~100 workspaces via Admin API for per-user cost control. Archived 'Claude Code' workspace was recreated 3 times in 2 days, each time inheriting org-level max spend limit and auto-assigning multiple users, completely bypassing the cost control workflow. User had to deploy AWS Lambda as workaround.

signals.topic: Config file corruption from race condition when using skill-creator
signals.summary: Users experience .claude.json corruption during high-frequency file system activity with skill-creator, causing config reset, loss of settings, and forced re-authentication
signals.review_reason: Data corruption is a severe user impact causing forced re-authentication and loss of settings. User reports this has happened multiple times in a month, demonstrating real-world frequency and impact.

source_issues.title: Skill Creator causes config file corruption
source_issues.evidence: User reports config file corruption requiring re-authentication multiple times in a month. Evidence shows non-atomic write path racing with atomic writes, producing corrupted JSON with leftover bytes from previous versions.

signals.topic: docx skill validate.py and pack.py crash on Windows due to UTF-8 encoding
signals.summary: The docx skill's validation and packaging scripts fail on Windows with UnicodeEncodeError/UnicodeDecodeError because they rely on default system encoding (cp1252) instead of explicit UTF-8
signals.review_reason: Complete workflow failure on Windows platform. User cannot use docx skill functionality without environment workarounds (PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8). Affects all Windows users working with docx skill.

source_issues.title: [Bug] docx skill: validate.py and pack.py crash on Windows due to missing UTF-8 encoding in file I/O and print output
source_issues.evidence: User provides detailed reproduction steps, error messages, and root cause analysis. Crash occurs in both output encoding (print with Unicode characters) and input encoding (reading XML files).

signals.topic: Bedrock Converse API native tool calling fails - arguments always empty
signals.summary: When using AWS Bedrock with native function calling, all tool arguments are silently dropped. The _parse_native_tool_call method incorrectly handles Bedrock's response format ({name, input, toolUseId}) because the code short-circuits on a truthy default '{}', never reading tool_call['input']. This causes pydantic validation failures on any tool with required parameters.
signals.review_reason: Blocks native function calling for all Bedrock users - tools with required parameters cannot work at all. Clear user impact with reproducible error and root cause identified.

signals.topic: Vector store search threshold produces inverted or broken results
signals.summary: The threshold parameter in Memory.search() silently produces wrong results for most vector stores. Distance-based stores (pgvector, chroma, redis, valkey, supabase, etc.) return inverted results - good matches get dropped while bad matches pass. Redis specifically returns vector_distance as string causing TypeError on threshold comparison.
signals.review_reason: Core search functionality is broken across multiple vector store backends. Users cannot reliably filter search results by threshold - the main API for memory retrieval returns incorrect or no results. Affects pgvector, chroma, redis, valkey, supabase and more.

source_issues.title: fix: threshold filtering broken for distance-based vector stores
source_issues.evidence: threshold filtering is inverted — good matches get dropped and bad matches pass through. A great match has distance ~0.05, so score=0.05 → 0.05 >= 0.7 is False → FILTERED OUT

source_issues.title: Redis vector_distance returned as string causes threshold search to fail

signals.review_reason: Blocks users from using latest OpenAI reasoning models (gpt-5, o1) - a critical functionality gap that produces broken agent outputs.
